record.paper_title: Open problems in the theory of fuzzy metric spaces
record.context_brief: Fuzzy analogues of Kantorovich and Gromov λ metrics.
record.original_question: In the setting of compact fuzzy metric-measure spaces and probability measures on fuzzy metric spaces, can one define fuzzy counterparts of the Kantorovich metric and of Gromov's λ-metric, analogous to the metrics used in the theory of metric-measure spaces?

evidence.quote: In the theory of mm-spaces, various metrics on the set of probability measures on a metric space are considered. Here, we mention only two examples: the Kantorovich metric (and its generalizations) [6] and the Gromov λ-metric [4, Chapter 3 1/2]. It is an open question to define counterparts of these metrics in the fuzzy setting.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and definitions.

(a) A fuzzy metric space, in the sense of George and Veeramani, is a triple (X, M, *) where X is a non-empty set, * is a continuous t-norm on [0,1], and M: X × X × (0, ∞) → [0,1] is a function satisfying, for all x, y, z ∈ X and t, s > 0:
  (i) M(x, y, t) > 0;
  (ii) M(x, y, t) = 1 if and only if x = y;
  (iii) M(x, y, t) = M(y, x, t);
  (iv) M(x, y, t) * M(y, z, s) ≤ M(x, z, t + s);
  (v) t ↦ M(x, y, t) is continuous from (0, ∞) to [0,1].
The space (X, M, *) is compact if the topology induced by M on X is compact.

(b) A fuzzy metric-measure space is a quadruple (X, M, *, μ) where (X, M, *) is a compact fuzzy metric space and μ is a Borel probability measure on X.

(c) Recall the classical analogues that should be mimicked:
  • Kantorovich (Wasserstein) metric. For a compact metric space (X, d) and probability measures μ, ν on X, dK(μ, ν) = inf_{π} ∫_{X×X} d(x, y) dπ(x, y), where the infimum is taken over all couplings π of μ and ν.
  • Gromov's λ-metric (or □λ-metric). Given a probability space (X, B, μ) and bounded measurable functions r, s: X × X → R, one defines □λ(r, s) as the infimum over measurable subsets A ⊂ X with μ(A) ≥ 1 − λ of sup_{x,y ∈ A} |r(x, y) − s(x, y)|; this extends to a metric on isomorphism classes of metric-measure spaces by taking the infimum over couplings of the two measures.

Problem. Construct fuzzy counterparts of the Kantorovich metric and of Gromov's λ-metric in the setting of compact fuzzy metric-measure spaces, namely:

1. Define, for a fixed compact fuzzy metric space (X, M, *), a fuzzy metric M_K on the set P(X) of Borel probability measures on X that plays the role of the Kantorovich metric, in the sense that for each t > 0 the value M_K(μ, ν, t) ∈ [0,1] reflects the optimal-transport cost between μ and ν computed against the fuzzy distance M, and verify that (P(X), M_K, *) is itself a fuzzy metric space.

2. Define a fuzzy analogue M_λ of Gromov's λ-metric on the collection of isomorphism classes of compact fuzzy metric-measure spaces (X, M, *, μ), establish that it satisfies the fuzzy metric axioms (up to isomorphism), and relate the induced topology to natural notions of convergence of fuzzy metric-measure spaces.

In both cases, the constructions should reduce, in the special case where the fuzzy metric M arises from an ordinary metric d (e.g. via M(x, y, t) = t/(t + d(x, y))), to the classical Kantorovich metric and to Gromov's λ-metric on metric-measure spaces, respectively.
artifact.status_search_result: A search reveals related developments — Gromov–Hausdorff fuzzy metrics on compact (non-Archimedean) fuzzy metric spaces and fuzzy analogues of Kantorovich-type distances in possibility-theoretic settings — but no construction is found that gives both a fuzzy Kantorovich metric on probability measures and a fuzzy Gromov λ-metric on fuzzy metric-measure spaces with the required compatibility. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Gromov-Hausdorff compactness theorem for non-Archimedean Fuzzy Metric Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: A Gromov-Hausdorff fuzzy metric is introduced in the setting of compact non-Archimedean fuzzy metric spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work develops Gromov-Hausdorff-type theory for fuzzy metric spaces, but does not provide the requested Kantorovich and λ-metric analogues on fuzzy mm-spaces.

status_evidence.title: The fuzzy metric space based on fuzzy measure
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of fuzzy metric spaces based on fuzzy measures.
status_evidence.claim: Related but does not solve the open question of fuzzy Kantorovich and Gromov λ-metrics for fuzzy metric-measure spaces.
